{{Top|leg}}
'''Target discs''' were used by individuals to train their skill with a weapon. Produced by a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], they could be programmed for a variety of skill settings, dependent on the user's expertise with a ranged weapon.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
